easy.def: A place set apart for one thing.
examples: Cars go slow in a school zone.
The ball went into the end zone.

more.def: An area that is set apart for a special use or that differs from the areas around it.
examples: There is a quiet zone in the library for reading.
The city made a car-free zone in the center.
Hard hats must be worn in the building zone.
The race car will zoom by.
The bee zooms by my ear.

more.def: To move very quickly, often with a humming sound.
examples: The bikes zoomed down the hill.
The skaters zoomed around the rink.
A motorcycle zoomed past us on the highway.
